note: WAEC Geography Paper 1 round 1 (Round 16e): the WASSCE syllabus with FRESH angles - Nigeria-specific stems (Lokoja confluence, Chappal Waddi, Chad Basin, Kainji Dam, Sokoto-Rima, 2006 census, Nanka gullies, 2012 floods), map-work calculations (045 degrees bearing, 5 cm at 1:50,000) and scenario items - because the near-dup scan checks every item against the JAMB, WAEC and NECO banks INCLUDING the big JAMB Geography banks (037-038) and the 87-item NECO Geography bank. Topics: the earth, weathering and landforms, weather and climate, map reading and settlement, population, regional geography of Nigeria, economic geography, environmental issues.
